ad_variants_mutation_ck.name: ad_variants_mutation_ck
ad_variants_mutation_ck.value:
(parent_variant_id IS NULL AND mutated_field IS NULL)
          OR
          (parent_variant_id IS NOT NULL AND mutated_field IS NOT NULL)

clients_objective_target_ck.name: clients_objective_target_ck
clients_objective_target_ck.value:
(default_objective_type = 'CPA'  AND default_target_cpa_cents IS NOT NULL AND default_target_cpa_cents > 0)
          OR
          (default_objective_type = 'ROAS' AND default_target_roas IS NOT NULL AND default_target_roas > 0)

creative_drafts_launched_ck.name: creative_drafts_launched_ck
creative_drafts_launched_ck.value: status <> 'LAUNCHED' OR launched_variant_id IS NOT NULL

creative_reviews_approved_ck.name: creative_reviews_approved_ck
creative_reviews_approved_ck.value: status <> 'APPROVED' OR (reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)

daily_performance_nonneg_ck.name: daily_performance_nonneg_ck
daily_performance_nonneg_ck.value:
impressions >= 0 AND clicks >= 0 AND spend_cents >= 0
          AND conversions >= 0 AND conversion_value_cents >= 0

decisions_log_executed_ck.name: decisions_log_executed_ck
decisions_log_executed_ck.value: status <> 'EXECUTED' OR executed_at IS NOT NULL

decisions_log_blocked_ck.name: decisions_log_blocked_ck
decisions_log_blocked_ck.value: status <> 'BLOCKED' OR blocked_by_rule IS NOT NULL

decisions_log_approved_ck.name: decisions_log_approved_ck
decisions_log_approved_ck.value: status <> 'APPROVED' OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)

guardrail_pct_bounds_ck.name: guardrail_pct_bounds_ck
guardrail_pct_bounds_ck.value:
max_budget_increase_pct > 0 AND max_budget_increase_pct <= 100
          AND max_budget_decrease_pct > 0 AND max_budget_decrease_pct <= 100

guardrail_p_bounds_ck.name: guardrail_p_bounds_ck
guardrail_p_bounds_ck.value:
kill_p_threshold > 0 AND kill_p_threshold <= 0.2
          AND scale_p_threshold > 0 AND scale_p_threshold <= 0.1
          AND scale_p_threshold <= kill_p_threshold

guardrail_money_bounds_ck.name: guardrail_money_bounds_ck
guardrail_money_bounds_ck.value:
max_daily_autonomous_increase_cents >= 0
          AND max_total_daily_budget_cents > 0
          AND min_ad_set_daily_budget_cents > 0
          AND max_ad_set_daily_budget_cents >= min_ad_set_daily_budget_cents
          AND max_ad_set_daily_budget_cents <= max_total_daily_budget_cents
          AND min_test_spend_cents > 0
          AND zero_conversion_kill_spend_cents > 0
          AND mutate_test_budget_cents > 0

guardrail_evidence_bounds_ck.name: guardrail_evidence_bounds_ck
guardrail_evidence_bounds_ck.value:
min_runtime_hours >= 24
          AND min_conversions_per_arm >= 1
          AND proxy_kill_min_impressions >= 500
          AND attribution_settling_hours >= 0
          AND approval_expiry_hours > 0
          AND max_mutation_depth >= 0
          AND action_cooldown_hours >= 0
          AND max_actions_per_cycle_per_client >= 0
          AND min_active_campaigns >= 0
          AND roas_bootstrap_min_days >= 2
          AND roas_bootstrap_iterations >= 100
          AND msprt_tau_relative > 0
